run_greeter_client: run the gRPC Greeter client that sends a SayHello request to localhost:50051
create_header_adder_interceptor: create a header adder interceptor that injects a one-time-password header into gRPC requests
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to connect to localhost:50051 for client communication
intercept_channel_with_headers: intercept a gRPC channel with a custom header adder interceptor before making RPC calls
call_sayhello_rpc: call the SayHello RPC method on the GreeterStub with a HelloRequest containing a name
